# NW Pennsylvania Roofing Quotes
> Connect with trusted local roofing contractors across NW Pennsylvania. Free estimates, no obligation.

## About
NW Pennsylvania Roofing Quotes is a lead generation site operated by TableTurn Digital, connecting homeowners across seven NW Pennsylvania counties with vetted local roofing contractors. Free estimates, fast response, no pressure.

## Services Covered
- Full roof replacement (asphalt shingle)
- Metal roof installation
- Storm and hail damage repair
- Leak repair
- Free roof and storm damage inspection (see below)
- Gutters and flashing
- Barn and agricultural roofing
- Camp and cabin roofing

## Service Area
Venango County, Crawford County, Warren County, Forest County, Clarion County, Butler County, Mercer County — Pennsylvania

## Primary Towns Served
Franklin, Oil City, Sugarcreek, Meadville, Titusville, Warren, Youngsville, Tionesta, Marienville, Clarion, Knox, Butler, Slippery Rock, Zelienople, Grove City, Hermitage, Sharon, Greenville, Mercer, Sandy Lake

## Free Roof and Storm Damage Inspection
- Page: https://nwpa-roofing-quotes.net/free-roof-inspection.html
- Homeowners can book a free roof inspection done by Bret Ruth, a local, independent inspector based in Franklin, PA, operating through TableTurn Digital.
- The inspection includes photo documentation and a plain summary of findings. If there is no damage, the homeowner is told so.
- After the inspection, homeowners are recommended to the crew that fits the job: an established storm restoration company for insurance related shingle, siding and gutter work, or experienced local crews (including Amish roofing crews) for metal roofs, barns, outbuildings and cash repairs. The homeowner makes the final choice.
- Free to homeowners. The contractor who is hired pays TableTurn Digital a referral fee once a job is sold.
- Not an insurance company or public adjuster. Does not negotiate insurance claims.
